content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text decides whether verses pressed against C3 were answered or unanswered and whether the line remains a broken link, which is what K-G4 governs.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"the line is cured by retraction, not defended: every witness pressed against C3 was named and answered in the challenger's own later rounds ((DR2) §C and (DR3) C3 quoting Matthew 1:18, 1:25 and Deuteronomy 22:24; (DR3) C4 quoting Luke 1:34), so the \"witness left unanswered\" ground fails and the collision is regraded UNDERDETERMINED;","rule_words":"A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.","room":"none","why":"Because the judge text says the witnesses were answered and cures the line by retraction, K-G4 does not count those verses as unanswered or toward a broken link."}
